title: How Effective Is Geo-Fencing for Local Advertising? Benefits, ROI & Real Examples

facts.fact: The page says geo-fenced messages can reach a user wherever they go for 30 days after the user enters a geo-fenced area, not only while at the location.
facts.quote: not only when they’re at the geo-fenced location but wherever they go over the next 30 days

facts.fact: The page says that, in some campaigns and industries, geo-fencing can produce conversion rates up to 20% or even 30% higher than traditional ads alone, citing unnamed studies.
facts.quote: businesses using geo-fencing can see conversion rates up to 20% or even 30% higher than those relying only on traditional ads

facts.fact: The page says geo-fencing can segment audiences down to the zip code level.
facts.quote: all the way down to the zip code level
